posts.text: I introduced the Six Penny Plan because the answer to our debt crisis isn't complicated. Cut six cents off every dollar. Balance the budget in five years. Protect your children's future. The only thing standing in the way is Washington's refusal to live within its means.
I've been the lone vote against runaway spending for years. It shouldn't be this hard to convince Washington to balance a checkbook. Every American does it. Washington should, too.
Thank God the President and all of the attendees tonight are safe.

Only American citizens should vote in American elections. That's not controversial. That's common sense.

The SAVE Act would have required proof of citizenship to register and vote. Four Republicans joined Democrats to kill it. Shameful.

The Founders knew exactly what they were doing. They lived under a government that searched without cause and seized without reason. They made sure we never would again. Defend the Fourth Amendment.
Your private messages are none of the government's business. Not without a warrant. I've been fighting warrantless surveillance since day one, and I'm not stopping now.

I didn't come to Washington to grow government. I came to shrink it. I’m proud to have earned the #1 spot on the Limited Government Index.

The FBI shouldn't be able to read your private messages without a warrant. Full stop. The Fourth Amendment doesn't have a national security exception.

I've been fighting warrantless surveillance for years, and I won't stop now.

Started the day off in Lexington this morning at an event hosted by UK’s Patterson School of Diplomacy where I spoke to students and faculty and answered their questions on foreign policy.
Great to be in my home county for the Warren County GOP Lincoln Day dinner last night! Always a good time seeing so many friends.

Washington doesn't have a revenue problem. It has a spending problem.

My Six Penny Plan is simple: cut six cents out of every dollar the federal government plans to spend. Do that for five years, and we balance the budget.
Safety and liberty are not a choice. My Fourth Amendment Restoration and Protection Act proves you can have both, without giving unelected agencies a blank check to spy on Americans.

We can fight terrorism without giving up our rights. Use 702 for foreign intelligence, but don’t search Americans without a warrant. Security and liberty aren’t mutually exclusive. @edhenry

Good intentions don't balance a checkbook. We passed a budget. Then ignored it. We spend $7T and bring in $5T. Until that changes, every budget document in Washington isn't worth the ink it's printed with. @VarneyCo

I just introduced bipartisan legislation to regulate hemp products and protect consumers. Washington has let this industry operate in a gray zone for too long. Americans deserve clarity about what they're buying. This is commonsense policy that crosses party lines. washingtonexaminer.com/news/…
Protect the privacy of American citizens. Reform FISA.

The Fourth Amendment is not optional. My Fourth Amendment Restoration and Protection Act bans warrantless surveillance of Americans, shuts down backdoor data searches, and limits secret courts to foreign targets only.

Washington doesn't have a revenue problem. It has a spending problem. My Six Penny Plan fixes it: cut 6 cents from every dollar spent for 5 years. Families balance their budgets. Washington should, too.
